title.en: An Act to Establish, Organize and Maintain One National Agricultural School in the Province of Zamboanga del Norte and to Appropriate the Sum of Three Hundred Thousand Pesos for the Purpose

text.en: The Secretary of Education is hereby authorized to establish, organize and maintain one national agricultural school in the Province of Zamboanga del Norte of the Central Luzon Agricultural School type.

The Secretary of Education is hereby empowered to locate and acquire or cause to be located and acquired a suitable site for the purpose of this Act, which may be public or private lands situated within the Province of Zamboanga del Norte.

The sum of three hundred thousand pesos, for its establishment and operation and maintenance during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and fifty-eight, is appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. Thereafter, the necessary appropriation for its maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
